entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: And the LORD answered Job out of the tempest, and said,

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: Who [is] this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Now gird up your loins like a man; for I will ask of you, and you teach Me.

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell if you have understanding!

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Who has set its measurements, for you know? Or who has stretched the line on it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: On what [are] its bases sunk, or who cast its cornerstone,

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, when it broke forth as it came from the womb?

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made the clouds its robe, and darkness its navel-band,

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: and set My limit on it, and set bars and doors,

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: and I said, You shall come to here, but no further; and here your proud waves shall stop.

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: Have you commanded the morning from your days, [and] caused the dawn to know its place,

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth; that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It is turned like clay [under] a seal; and they stand forth like a garment.

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: And from the wicked their light is withheld, and the high arm shall be broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: Have you gone to the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in search of the depths?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the gates of death been opened to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Have you understood the breadth of the earth? Tell, if you know it all!

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Where [is] the way [where] light dwells? And where [is] the place of darkness,

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: that you should take it to its boundary, and that you should know the paths [to] its house?

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: You know, because you were born then. And the number of your days [is] great?

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: Have you entered into the storehouses of the snow? Or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: which I have kept for the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: How [is] it, way the light distributed, [and how does] the east wind spread itself on the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: Who has cut a channel for the flood, or a way for the thunderclaps;

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: to cause rain to fall on the earth [where] no man [is], a wilderness and no man in it;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: to satisfy the desolate and waste ground, and to cause the source of grass to spring forth?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Has the rain a father? Or who has brought forth the drops of dew?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the frost of the heavens, who fathered it?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: The waters are hidden like stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: Can you bind the bands of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Can you bring the constellations in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with its sons?

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you set up their rulership on the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, so that floods of waters may cover you?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Can you send lightnings, that they may go, and say to you, Here we [are]?

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Who can number the clouds by wisdom; or who can empty out the jars of the heavens,

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: when the dust is melted [into] hardness, and the clods cling fast together?

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: Will you hunt the prey for the lion, or fill the appetite of the young lions,

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: when they crouch in dens, [and] sit in the cover of their hiding place?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who provides food for the raven, when its young ones cry to God [and] wander about without food?
